notes.sol: Use the supplied original data and R code. Rebuilt Census/CCES measures, the multiverse and Nationscape are separate analyses and are excluded.
notes.claude: Reconciled with the second labeller (see reconciliation.md). The final judgement is the structured label; notes_blind_original keeps the pre-reconciliation blind notes, which are historical and superseded wherever they conflict with the final label.
notes.claude_blind_original_historical: Report compared against HW appendix Table A3 rather than main-text Table 1; the shipped an_main.R writes Table 1 and Table A3 from the same texreg call ('TABLE 1 AND TABLE A3'), so the exhibit difference is cosmetic. Report used the Harvard Dataverse package (doi:10.7910/DVN/FMOR6K, v3.0), not the REPRO-Bench snapshot; REPRO-Bench folder 4 contains the same an_main.R. Report made only path edits ('allowing for opening the data file from a different location'), not a P0. Report's N Clusters were 'Not Reported' in the replication column (display only). Sections 3-5 (reconstruction, multiverse, Nationscape) are robustness and were ignored. Paper itself not accessed.
